business_problem: Volatile energy markets demanded faster access to trading, risk, and operational data than Uniper's aging reporting platform and fragmented systems could provide.
solution_summary: Uniper built a central data and AI foundation on Snowflake to consolidate trading, risk, pricing, optimization, and power-generation data and make it useful at business speed. The company migrated a decade-old reporting platform into Snowflake, giving teams cloud scalability without the storage constraints and upkeep that previously consumed engineering capacity. Key data sets now land on one platform, and start-of-day reports are available earlier so decision-makers can react to market shifts and operational issues during business hours rather than after long batch delays. On top of that governed backbone, Uniper uses Snowflake CoCo and Snowflake CoWork to develop AI agents that combine safety instructions, security guidance, failure history, market prices, and maintenance schedules to recommend the best times and procedures for UK power-plant maintenance. Employees also use CoCo to diagnose non-performant SQL and enable more self-service optimization.
